CREATE TABLE v2_blobs (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	record_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	object_key VARCHAR(1024), 
	object_version VARCHAR(512), 
	verified_size BIGINT, 
	verified_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	part_size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	grant_expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	pending_deletion BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (record_id, path), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, record_id) REFERENCES v2_records (space_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE v2_coordination_inputs (
	attempt_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	record_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id, record_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, attempt_id) REFERENCES v2_coordinations (space_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, record_id) REFERENCES v2_records (space_id, id)
);
INSERT INTO "v2_coordination_inputs" VALUES('coord','record','space');

CREATE TABLE v2_coordinations (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reference_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	expected_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	holder VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	lease_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	result_record_id VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (space_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, reference_name) REFERENCES v2_references (space_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, result_record_id) REFERENCES v2_records (space_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE "v2_events" (
        id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        record_id VARCHAR(64),
        type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        principal_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        payload JSON NOT NULL,
        created_at FLOAT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES v2_spaces (id)
    );
INSERT INTO "v2_events" VALUES(1,'space',NULL,'event','alice','null',1.79461090300090909e+09);

CREATE TABLE v2_kind_policies (
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	publish_roles JSON NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (space_id, kind), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES v2_spaces (id)
);
INSERT INTO "v2_kind_policies" VALUES('space','thing','["contributor", "publisher"]','shared',1);

CREATE TABLE v2_managed_spaces (
        space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        job_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, retired_at FLOAT,
        FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES v2_spaces(id));

CREATE TABLE v2_members (
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	principal_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(256), 
	roles JSON NOT NULL, 
	bindings JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (space_id, principal_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES v2_spaces (id)
);
INSERT INTO "v2_members" VALUES('space','alice',NULL,'null','"ordinary JSON string"');

CREATE TABLE v2_operations (
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	principal_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	response JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (space_id, principal_id, scope, "key")
);

CREATE TABLE v2_records (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	schema_revision_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	creator VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	creator_bindings JSON NOT NULL, 
	base_record_id VARCHAR(64), 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	shared BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	declared_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	metadata_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	published_at FLOAT, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (space_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES v2_spaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, schema_revision_id) REFERENCES v2_schema_revisions (space_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, base_record_id) REFERENCES v2_records (space_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE v2_references (
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	record_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (space_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id, record_id) REFERENCES v2_records (space_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE v2_schema_ledger (revision VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY);

CREATE TABLE v2_schema_revisions (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema JSON NOT NULL, 
	profile_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	dialect VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES v2_spaces (id), 
	UNIQUE (space_id, kind, revision), 
	UNIQUE (space_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE v2_spaces (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	profile VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quota_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	principal_quota_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	allocated BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reclaiming BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	quota_records BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	record_count BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	quota_metadata_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	metadata_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	event_floor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE v2_transfer_attempts (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	blob_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_attempt FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	last_error VARCHAR(256), 
	upload_handle JSON NOT NULL, 
	mutation_tokens JSON NOT NULL, 
	grant_expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(blob_id) REFERENCES v2_blobs (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
);

CREATE TABLE v2_workload_grants (
        id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        space_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, principal_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        subject VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, job_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
        attempt_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, component_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
        epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, roles JSON NOT NULL, bindings JSON NOT NULL,
        certificate_thumbprint VARCHAR(43) NOT NULL, expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL,
        enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, revoked_at FLOAT,
        FOREIGN KEY(space_id, principal_id) REFERENCES v2_members(space_id, principal_id));
